premise: On a cosy dark night Owl and Raccoon notice a soft light in the moss; it is Mushroom, glowing and shy about it; they tell her she is the best night-light in the forest.
inspiration: The Little Candle folk motif (a small light that thinks it doesn't matter), turned: the small light is celebrated and lights the way home.

en-US.title: Mushroom Glows
en-US.text: Night came to the forest, soft and dark and cosy. Owl {owl:pulse} and Raccoon {raccoon:pulse} woke up. But down in the moss, something was different. A little light. {mushroom:glow 0.5 hold} Green and gentle. Raccoon crept closer. Owl {owl:float 0.4} swooped down. It was Mushroom. Mushroom? said Owl. You're glowing! Mushroom {mushroom:wobble} wobbled. Oh, she said. Sorry. I can't help it. It happens when it's dark. {mushroom:glow 0.3 hold} The light got dimmer. Don't, said Raccoon. Please don't. Look, said Owl. Because of you I can see the path. Because of you, said Raccoon, I can see my own paws. Because of you, said Frog, the pond has a little green moon in it. Mushroom went quiet. Then, slowly, {mushroom:glow 0.9 hold} she glowed brighter than ever. Oh, she said. I'm a night-light. The best one, said Owl. And they sat in her light till morning.

es-ES.title: Seta brilla
es-ES.text: Llegó la noche al bosque, suave, oscura y acogedora. Búho {owl:pulse} y Mapache {raccoon:pulse} se despertaron. Pero abajo, en el musgo, algo era distinto. Una lucecita. {mushroom:glow 0.5 hold} Verde y suave. Mapache se acercó despacio. Búho {owl:float 0.4} bajó planeando. Era Seta. ¿Seta?, dijo Búho. ¡Estás brillando! Seta {mushroom:wobble} se tambaleó. Ay, dijo. Perdón. No lo puedo evitar. Me pasa cuando está oscuro. {mushroom:glow 0.3 hold} La luz bajó. No, dijo Mapache. Por favor, no. Mira, dijo Búho. Gracias a ti veo el camino. Gracias a ti, dijo Mapache, me veo las manos. Gracias a ti, dijo Rana, el estanque tiene una lunita verde dentro. Seta se quedó callada. Y luego, despacio, {mushroom:glow 0.9 hold} brilló más que nunca. Anda, dijo. Soy una lamparita. La mejor, dijo Búho. Y se quedaron con ella, en su luz, hasta la mañana.
